visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with a short haircut, wearing a light blue t-shirt and grey pants, stands at a food preparation station. He is wearing a green surgical mask and black wireless earbuds. He expertly handles a large piece of thin, pale dough, stretching and flipping it over a large metal counter covered in white flour. The background shows a busy market stall environment with yellow banners and kitchen equipment. (2) The scene shifts to close-up shots of food assembly. Hands wearing transparent plastic gloves place a variety of ingredients onto a large wrap. These include a thick layer of shredded green cabbage, white onion slices, and a generous scoop of a yellow-brown mixture consisting of chickpeas and minced meat. Red chili sauce and white mayonnaise are squeezed over the fillings. The lighting is bright and natural, typical of an outdoor covered market. (3) Two completed Mexican-style wraps, tightly rolled and wrapped in white paper, are presented directly to the camera. The camera zooms in to show the dense layers of meat, vegetables, and sauce inside. The man is then shown folding more wraps at the stall. The final shots show the exterior of the 'Ali Mexican Sandwich' stall located on a city sidewalk next to a street with passing traffic under clear daylight.
